<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="שבט_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518916442_theRebbe_16" batchId="meluket-_D7_A9_D7_91_D7_98_meluket__BH_POST_1766518916442_theRebbe_16__p009">
  <section v="24">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>After a brief talk by the Rebbe, the recitation of "Lamnatzeiach Yaanecha" and the completion of the Torah scroll.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">After a brief talk by the Rebbe shlita,</t>
    <t s="1">the recitation of the verses of "Lamnatzeiach Yaanecha" by R. Shalom HaLevi Lewitin obm, with the congregation responding verse by verse,</t>
    <t s="2">and the melodies of our Rebbes — the writing of the Torah scroll was completed.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="25">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>After reciting "Atah Hareisa," the Torah scroll was rolled, crowned, and carried to the Ark, and the Rebbe recited the Shehecheyanu blessing over a new fruit.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And after reciting the verses of "Atah Hareisa"21,</t>
    <t s="1">the melody "Perazot Teishev Yerushalayim",</t>
    <t s="2">the rolling of the Torah scroll and the donning of the "crown"22</t>
    <t s="3">by the Rebbe shlita,</t>
    <t s="4">the carrying of the Torah scroll to the Holy Ark under a chuppah and accompanied by candles — the Rebbe shlita recited the "Shehecheyanu" blessing aloud,</t>
    <t s="5">and ate a new fruit.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="26">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Afterwards, the Rebbe delivered a maamar beginning "Lehavin Inyan Ksivas Sefer Torah" and a short talk.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">Afterwards, he delivered a maamar beginning with the words "Lehavin Inyan Ksivas Sefer Torah",</t>
    <t s="1">which is printed here,</t>
    <t s="2">and a short talk.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: After a brief talk by the Rebbe, the recitation of "Lamnatzeiach Yaanecha" and the completion of the Torah scroll.

translations.translation: After a brief talk by the Rebbe shlita,
the recitation of the verses of "Lamnatzeiach Yaanecha" by R. Shalom HaLevi Lewitin obm, with the congregation responding verse by verse,
and the melodies of our Rebbes — the writing of the Torah scroll was completed.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: After reciting "Atah Hareisa," the Torah scroll was rolled, crowned, and carried to the Ark, and the Rebbe recited the Shehecheyanu blessing over a new fruit.

translations.translation: And after reciting the verses of "Atah Hareisa"21,
the rolling of the Torah scroll and the donning of the "crown"22
the carrying of the Torah scroll to the Holy Ark under a chuppah and accompanied by candles — the Rebbe shlita recited the "Shehecheyanu" blessing aloud,

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Afterwards, the Rebbe delivered a maamar beginning "Lehavin Inyan Ksivas Sefer Torah" and a short talk.

translations.translation: Afterwards, he delivered a maamar beginning with the words "Lehavin Inyan Ksivas Sefer Torah",
